_comment: Curated starting points for local inference via Ollama, not an exhaustive
registry — Ollama publishes no API for browsing its library, so this list
is maintained by hand and is meant to be edited.
size_mb is the approximate on-disk/in-memory footprint of the default
quantization Ollama pulls for that tag. Treat it as a sizing hint, not a
guarantee: quantization choices move these numbers considerably.
Verify a tag exists before relying on it: `ollama show <tag>`.

models.name: Qwen2.5 0.5B
models.good_for: Smoke-testing the pipeline on any machine, including a Pi.

models.name: Llama 3.2 1B
models.good_for: Fast replies on a laptop with no dedicated GPU.

models.name: Llama 3.2 3B
models.good_for: General chat on modest hardware. A sensible floor.

models.name: Phi-4
models.good_for: Reasoning and maths well above its size class.

models.name: Qwen2.5 Coder 7B
models.good_for: Code completion and review. Pairs well with the gateway.

models.name: Qwen2.5 Coder 32B
models.good_for: The strongest local coding model most desktops can hold.

models.name: Mistral Small
models.good_for: Balanced general use with a long context.

models.name: DeepSeek R1 70B
models.good_for: Serious reasoning, if you have the VRAM for it.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.good_for: Broad general capability at the top of consumer hardware.

models.name: GLM-5.2
models.good_for: The model Sensei is designed around. Needs a server, not a desktop — most people should reach it through an API provider instead.
